Kalimba body

How to use this view

Drag to turn, scroll or pinch to zoom; draw Explode to take it apart. Every part is the cut file’s own outline at 3mm: the plain face with its round hole underneath, seven finger-jointed walls, and the septafoil rosette face on top. The sheet’s three optional stiffeners are left out, because nothing says where under the rosette face they go. The tines and bridge are not part of this build.
